Scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得自己没有钱，when the person affected is the same as the subject, use 自己 to show that relationship clearly instead of repeating the name.
Run 2: Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得她没有钱，use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when no other female character competes as the referent.
Run 3: Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得自己没有钱，When the affected person is the same as the subject of the clause, use 自己 to make that relationship clear and avoid repeating the name in the same sentence.

output.reason: All runs address the repeated reference to 孟母 in the same clause and replace it appropriately with 自己 or 她.
